## Objective

Apply the vessel crosswalk and gear corrections from `03_review_vessels.qmd`
to every VP and AFE record, build the two analysis sets, and write the
record-level and cell-level tables the spatial analysis reads.

This step needs only the raw pull, the grid and the tracked files in
`references/`. It does not read the GARFO permit lists or the API caches, and
it writes nothing to `references/`, so anyone with the raw pull can reproduce
the analysis tables. It rebuilds the crosswalk from its tracked inputs and
stops if the result differs from `references/vessel_crosswalk.csv`: re-render
`03_review_vessels.qmd` after any change to those inputs.

| Input (`references/`) | Role |
|---|---|
| `vessel_crosswalk.csv` | Hull and activity class per MMSI and validity window (generated by 03) |
| `vessel_removals.csv`, `orsted_fv_survey_dates_*.csv`, `orsted_survey_vessels.csv`, `vessel_decisions.csv` | The crosswalk's inputs, used here only to check it is current |
| `vessel_gear.csv` | Gear corrections |
| `vessel_permit_groups.csv` | GARFO permit group per MMSI, for the dual-permit check (generated by 03) |

## Libraries and shared code

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

source("r/paths.R")
source("r/gfw_helpers.R")
source("r/vessel_helpers.R")

# Quarto parameters (header); `params` is read-only while rendering. Run chunk
# by chunk (Positron, RStudio), `params` is missing or left over from another
# session, so the header is read from this file directly instead
qparams <- if (isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) params else {
  hdr <- knitr::knit_params(readLines(
    file.path(root, "r/04_classify_aggregate.qmd"), warn = FALSE))
  lapply(hdr, function(p) p$value)
}
paths <- gfw_paths_with(qparams)
```

## Read raw data and the grid

```{r}
# read_gfw() (r/gfw_helpers.R) types the hours, derives Year Month and
# Development Stage, and snaps Lat/Lon to the 0.01 degree cell_id; records
# after analysis_end are dropped
vp  <- read_gfw(paths$raw_vp)  |> in_analysis_window()
afe <- read_gfw(paths$raw_afe) |> in_analysis_window()

stopifnot("records with no development stage" =
            !anyNA(vp$`Development Stage`) && !anyNA(afe$`Development Stage`))

total_vp  <- sum(vp$hours)
total_afe <- sum(afe$hours)

pull_date  <- read_pull_date(paths)
gfw_labels <- gfw_labels_of(vp, afe)

grid <- st_read(paths$grid, quiet = TRUE)

stopifnot("records outside the fishnet grid" =
            all(c(vp$cell_id, afe$cell_id) %in% grid$cell_id))
```

## The crosswalk and gear corrections

```{r}
decisions <- read_chr(paths$decisions)
stopifnot("decision must be accept or reject" =
            all(decisions$decision %in% c("accept", "reject")))

cw_file <- read_chr(paths$crosswalk) |> select(all_of(cw_cols))

# the crosswalk 03 would write from the current inputs
cw_rebuilt <- build_crosswalk(paths, decisions, gfw_labels, pull_date)

cw_key <- \(d) d |> arrange(across(everything())) |> as.data.frame()
if (!isTRUE(all.equal(cw_key(cw_file), cw_key(cw_rebuilt), check.attributes = FALSE))) {
  stop(paths$crosswalk, " does not match its inputs (removals, survey dates, ",
       "decisions or the raw pull have changed). Re-render 03_review_vessels.qmd ",
       "to regenerate it.", call. = FALSE)
}

cw   <- type_crosswalk(cw_file, gfw_labels, source = paths$crosswalk)
gear <- validate_gear(read_chr(paths$gear), source = paths$gear)

count(cw, hull_class, activity_excluded)
count(gear, gear_class, basis)
```

## Classify every record

Each record is matched to at most one crosswalk row by MMSI and date. Records
with no row keep GFW's label. Two analysis sets follow:

| Set | Records kept |
|---|---|
| **Strict** | GFW `Vessel Type == FISHING`, nothing else applied: the unprocessed GFW data |
| **Primary** | Strict, minus the crosswalk's non-fishing hulls, charter and survey windows (removal list, survey dates and accepted decisions) and gear markers, plus the fishing hulls GFW missed (accepted decisions) |

Every crosswalk row counts as verified, so the difference between the two
sets is the effect of the processing.

Each record's `gear_class` is the accepted correction in `vessel_gear.csv`
whose window contains its date, otherwise GFW's `Gear Type` through the gear
map; `gear_source` says which. `gear_class_gfw` keeps GFW's gear for the
Strict set. `classify()` is in `r/vessel_helpers.R`.

```{r}
vp_cls  <- classify(vp, cw, gear)
afe_cls <- classify(afe, cw, gear)
```

```{r}
set_cols <- c("in_strict", "in_primary")

bind_rows(VP = vp_cls, AFE = afe_cls, .id = "dataset") |>
  group_by(dataset) |>
  summarise(across(all_of(set_cols), \(x) sum(hours[x])),
            total = sum(hours), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
dir.create(paths$processed_gfw, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(vp_cls,  file.path(paths$processed_gfw, "gfw_vp_id_classified.csv"),  na = "")
write_csv(afe_cls, file.path(paths$processed_gfw, "gfw_afe_id_classified.csv"), na = "")
```

## Account for what is left

### Stage totals and Stage 2 → 3 change by set

```{r}
to_long <- function(df) {
  df |>
    pivot_longer(all_of(set_cols), names_to = "set", values_to = "keep") |>
    filter(keep) |>
    mutate(set = factor(str_remove(set, "in_"),
                        levels = c("strict", "primary")))
}

stage_by_set <- bind_rows(VP = to_long(vp_cls), AFE = to_long(afe_cls), .id = "dataset") |>
  group_by(dataset, set, `Development Stage`) |>
  summarise(hours = sum(hours), n_mmsi = n_distinct(MMSI), .groups = "drop")

stage_by_set

stage_by_set |>
  select(-n_mmsi) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Development Stage`, values_from = hours) |>
  mutate(change_s2_s3_pct = round(100 * (`Stage 3` - `Stage 2`) / `Stage 2`, 1))
```

### Fishing effort missing for added vessels

GFW computes AFE only for vessels it treats as fishing, so hulls added in
Primary have presence hours but almost no effort hours. Report this as a known
undercount. The imputation below applies each stage's effort-to-presence ratio
(from GFW FISHING vessels kept in Primary, by gear class) to the added
vessels' presence hours; use it as a sensitivity check only.

```{r}
added <- vp_cls |> filter(added, in_primary)

kept_gfw <- function(df) filter(df, in_primary, gfw_fishing)
ratio <- inner_join(
  vp_cls  |> kept_gfw() |> group_by(`Development Stage`, gear_class) |>
    summarise(vp = sum(hours), .groups = "drop"),
  afe_cls |> kept_gfw() |> group_by(`Development Stage`, gear_class) |>
    summarise(afe = sum(hours), .groups = "drop"),
  by = c("Development Stage", "gear_class")) |>
  mutate(afe_per_vp = afe / vp)

added |>
  group_by(`Development Stage`, gear_class) |>
  summarise(vp_hours = sum(hours), n_mmsi = n_distinct(MMSI), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(afe_cls |> filter(added, in_primary) |>
              group_by(`Development Stage`, gear_class) |>
              summarise(afe_hours_reported = sum(hours), .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("Development Stage", "gear_class")) |>
  left_join(select(ratio, `Development Stage`, gear_class, afe_per_vp),
            by = c("Development Stage", "gear_class")) |>
  mutate(afe_hours_reported = coalesce(afe_hours_reported, 0),
         afe_hours_imputed  = vp_hours * afe_per_vp)
```

### Dual-permitted vessels

Vessels whose GARFO permits combine for-hire with commercial permits
(`commercial + for-hire`, `for-hire + open-access commercial`) may fish both
ways, on different trips. A single gear class cannot represent them, so report
their hours as a separate group and check whether the Stage 2 → 3 change holds
with them excluded. The groups come from `references/vessel_permit_groups.csv`
(written by 03): only unique, year-overlapping GARFO matches that PSIX does
not contradict are grouped; everything else is `no unique GARFO match`.

```{r}
permit_group <- read_chr(paths$permit_groups) |> select(MMSI, permit_group)

bind_rows(VP = to_long(vp_cls), AFE = to_long(afe_cls), .id = "dataset") |>
  left_join(permit_group, by = "MMSI") |>
  mutate(permit_group = coalesce(permit_group, "no unique GARFO match")) |>
  group_by(dataset, set, permit_group, `Development Stage`) |>
  summarise(hours = sum(hours), n_mmsi = n_distinct(MMSI), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Development Stage`, values_from = c(hours, n_mmsi),
              values_fill = 0)
```

### Cell tables by set

Same zero-filled layout as `02_build_grid.qmd`, with a `set` column, ready
for the spatial analysis. Each table is zero-filled across every grid cell,
every development stage or every month of the analysis window, both sets and,
in the gear tables, all four gear classes:

| File (`data/interim/gfw/`, VP and AFE) | One row per |
|---|---|
| `gfw_{vp,afe}_cell_stage_sets.csv` | cell × stage × set |
| `gfw_{vp,afe}_cell_month_sets.csv` | cell × month × set |
| `gfw_{vp,afe}_cell_stage_gear_sets.csv` | cell × stage × set × gear class |
| `gfw_{vp,afe}_cell_month_gear_sets.csv` | cell × month × set × gear class |

The gear tables use the same gear as the gear summary below: GFW's gear
(`gear_class_gfw`) for Strict, the corrected `gear_class` for Primary.
`n_mmsi` counts vessels within each row, so it does not sum across gear
classes or months to a vessel total.

```{r}
months      <- seq(min(vp$`Year Month`), max(vp$`Year Month`), by = "month")
time_levels <- list(`Development Stage` = dev_stages$stage, `Year Month` = months)

cell_sets <- function(df, value, time, by_gear = FALSE) {
  long <- to_long(df) |>
    mutate(gear_class = if_else(set == "strict", gear_class_gfw, gear_class))
  stopifnot("gear class outside the four analysis classes" =
              all(long$gear_class %in% gear_classes),
            "time value outside the zero-fill levels" =
              all(long[[time]] %in% time_levels[[time]]))

  keys   <- c("cell_id", time, "set", if (by_gear) "gear_class")
  levels <- c(list(cell_id = grid$cell_id), time_levels[time],
              list(set = levels(long$set)),
              if (by_gear) list(gear_class = gear_classes))

  out <- long |>
    group_by(across(all_of(keys))) |>
    summarise("{value}" := sum(hours), n_mmsi = n_distinct(MMSI), .groups = "drop") |>
    complete(!!!levels, fill = set_names(list(0, 0L), c(value, "n_mmsi")))

  stopifnot("zero-filled table has the wrong number of rows" =
              nrow(out) == prod(lengths(levels)),
            "hours lost in aggregation" =
              isTRUE(all.equal(sum(out[[value]]), sum(long$hours))))
  out
}

cell_tables <- list(
  cell_stage_sets      = list(time = "Development Stage", by_gear = FALSE),
  cell_month_sets      = list(time = "Year Month",        by_gear = FALSE),
  cell_stage_gear_sets = list(time = "Development Stage", by_gear = TRUE),
  cell_month_gear_sets = list(time = "Year Month",        by_gear = TRUE))

dir.create(paths$interim_gfw, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (tbl in names(cell_tables)) {
  spec <- cell_tables[[tbl]]
  write_csv(cell_sets(vp_cls, "vp_hours", spec$time, spec$by_gear),
            file.path(paths$interim_gfw, paste0("gfw_vp_", tbl, ".csv")))
  write_csv(cell_sets(afe_cls, "afe_hours", spec$time, spec$by_gear),
            file.path(paths$interim_gfw, paste0("gfw_afe_", tbl, ".csv")))
}
```

## Summaries for the methods

### Crosswalk summary

```{r}
touched <- function(df) {
  df |>
    filter(!is.na(cw_hull)) |>
    group_by(cw_hull, cw_excluded) |>
    summarise(hours = sum(hours), .groups = "drop")
}

count(cw, hull_class, activity_excluded, name = "rows")

full_join(touched(vp_cls), touched(afe_cls),
          by = c("cw_hull", "cw_excluded"),
          suffix = c("_vp", "_afe")) |>
  mutate(share_vp  = round(hours_vp  / total_vp,  4),
         share_afe = round(hours_afe / total_afe, 4))
```

### Gear summary

How much of each set's fishing effort has a resolved gear class, and how much
of it comes from your gear corrections rather than GFW. Strict uses GFW's gear
(`gear_class_gfw`); Primary uses the corrected `gear_class`.

```{r}
to_long(afe_cls) |>
  mutate(gear_source = if_else(set == "strict", "gfw", gear_source),
         gear_class  = if_else(set == "strict", gear_class_gfw, gear_class)) |>
  group_by(set, gear_class, gear_source) |>
  summarise(afe_hours = round(sum(hours)), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(set) |>
  mutate(share = round(afe_hours / sum(afe_hours), 3)) |>
  ungroup()
```
